at the bottom-left — and the avatar above it, with a name and image you choose, so screenshots do n
ot expose the original.
# dsh-accountdisplayname-edit

Replaces the sidebar account label — the phone number, email, or account name
DeepSeek Harness shows

at the bottom-left — and the avatar above it, with a name
and image you choose, so screenshots do n
ot expose the original.

The edit entry is a new **Edit display name** row in the account menu, the one you
open by clicking
that label. The dialog it opens holds both the avatar and the name.
## What it does

- Replaces the account label text in the sidebar footer with a display name you set.
- Replaces the

launcher avatar with an image you pick from a local file.
- Adds an **Edit display name** / **编辑显示名称

** row to the account menu, directly
under Settings.
- Opens one editor dialog for both: pick or cle

ar an avatar, type a name, then Save,
Cancel, or Use default. `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels.
- Both e

dits are drafts until Save — Cancel leaves the sidebar untouched.
- Saving an empty value restores t

he account's own text; clearing the avatar restores
the account's own avatar.
- A picked image is ce

ntre-cropped square, downscaled to 128×128 and re-encoded, so
the stored copy stays in the low tens

of KB.
- Stores both per browser in `localStorage`, under
`dsh.account-display-name-edit.alias` and

`dsh.account-display-name-edit.avatar`.
- Display only. The account, the credentials and the profile

are never read or
changed, and the plugin makes no network requests of its own.
## Requirements

Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The account launcher and `Menu` DOM it
targets — `data-

signed-out`, the `_avatar` / `_label` spans, the portaled
`div[role="menu"]` with its `role="present

ation"` viewport and `itemIcon` /
`itemLabel` rows — is unchanged in `0.2.1-rc.2`, which this packag

e was checked
against. The host half imports nothing and the browser half fails soft, so a build
who

se DOM has moved on degrades to "no override, no extra row" rather than an error —
see Compatibility

e DOM has moved on degrades to "no override, no extra row" rather than an error —
see Compatibility.

The `desktop` profile is managed exclusively by the Electron application, so install
it there throug

h the app's own plugin surface (Settings → Plugins, or `dshmarket`);
the CLI refuses that profile by

p's own plugin surface (Settings → Plugins, or `dshmarket`);
the CLI refuses that profile by design.

les/dsh-accountdisplayname-edit`.

That patch layer is watched, so it applies live — no restart needed.
## How it works
A dual-face plugin whose host half does almost nothing.

- **Host half — `lib/index.js`.** Deliberately import-free. Its only job is to be a
Loader entry, so

the host's client-module scanner reads `dsh.client` from
`package.json` and serves `./client` to th

e browser. With no dependencies and no
`peerDependencies`, it cannot fail to load because of a missi

ng, renamed or
version-mismatched peer package.
- **Browser half — `lib/client.js`.** A hand-written

single-file bundle, already in
the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` form the module

system serves
verbatim, so the package needs no build. It requires only `react`, which the shell
see
ds as a platform module — which is why `react` is not a dependency either.
### Why the menu row is done in the DOM

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` renders that menu from a hard-coded
`items` array, and

its only slot (`settings.launcher`, a `single` slot) is the
launcher row itself. Occupying that slo

t would delete 设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录, which
this plugin must not do. There is no menu-item slot to add to

would delete 设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录, which
this plugin must not do. There is no menu-item slot to add to.

So the row is appended to the **open** menu's list, cloned from a shipped row — it
therefore inherit

s that build's exact markup, classes and styling. Appending one
node leaves React's own children unt

ouched, and the row is removed with the menu
because React never tracked it.
Selectors use only stable identifiers, never a hashed CSS-module prefix:

- the launcher is `button[aria-haspopup="menu"][data-signed-out]`, an attribute the
account componen

t always writes; the text node is found by the `_label` suffix and
the avatar by the `_avatar` suffi

x, with positional fallbacks;
- the menu is a `div[role="menu"]` the `Menu` primitive portals to `<b

ody>`,
identified as the one that appeared after the launcher was activated.
## Compatibility

- `dsh.client.immediately: true` is required: the plugin works through side effects
registered when

its bundle materializes, so it belongs in the boot graph's
immediate tier.
- No `engines.dsh` range

is declared, on purpose. node-semver only admits a
prerelease version when some comparator in the ra

nge shares its exact
`major.minor.patch` tuple and itself carries a prerelease tag, so any range wou

ld
silently exclude a later prerelease of the harness — the failure mode the
awesome-dsh-plugin cont

ributing guide warns about. Failing soft is the safer
contract here.
## Known limitations

- The menu row and the avatar override depend on the shipped account-menu DOM. A
future release that

restructures it silently drops that part — nothing breaks, but
the row or the avatar stops updating

until this package follows the change.
- The name and the avatar live in this browser's `localStora

ge`, so they are
per-origin and not synced across machines. They never reach the account.
- The avat

ar is stored as a 128×128 PNG data URL. A file over 10 MB, or an encoding
that still exceeds the sto

rage cap, is rejected with a message instead of being
silently dropped.
- Only Simplified Chinese an

d English strings are bundled; the UI follows the client
locale and falls back to Chinese.
